subject: english
question:
**Change the following from active to passive:**

They had sent the invitations by courier.

options.text: The invitations were sent by courier.
The invitations have been sent by courier.
The invitations had been sent by courier.
The invitations had been being sent by courier.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They had sent the invitations by courier."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the invitations" at the beginning of the sentence.
